topic: Terms of a new space can be written only after its terms_file is applied
detail: SetSpaceTerms writes only the applied revision's terms_file of an applied space, so a draft (which an agent session may save) can never point orchd at a file to write. A new space, or a changed terms_file path, therefore needs Save Draft and Apply before Replace Terms works; the editor disables the button and orchd's FailedPrecondition says so. If the two steps prove awkward, Apply could offer to write terms for spaces whose terms_file it just applied.
